overview: The City Council approved an $800,000 Community Preservation Act grant for the Walkling Court redevelopment, advanced three proposed city charter amendments to a May public hearing, and authorized third readings for a sidewalk loan order and non-union wage adjustments following extensive debate over municipal finances.

items.title: Condolence Resolution: Stella Tanaglia
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences to the family of Stella Tanaglia, a longtime city finance department employee.

items.title: Meeting Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the records of the April 11, 2023 meeting and committee reports regarding the zoning RFP and the Community Development Block Grant action plan.

items.title: Special Permit: 640 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a cafe and eating place at 640 Boston Avenue, subject to Community Development Board review and the six-day public comment period.

items.title: Special Permit: 16 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit for paranormal retail services and sales for Maylene's Spiritual Shop at 16 Main Street, pending Community Development Board review and the public comment period.

items.title: Paranormal License: 16 Main Street
items.summary: Approved an operating license for Maylene's Spiritual Shop at 16 Main Street.

items.title: 2022 Elections After-Action Report Update
items.summary: Received and placed on file an update from the Elections Commission and Election Manager regarding preparations, poll pads, ADA access, and lessons learned from the 2022 elections.

items.title: CPA Appropriation: Walkling Court Redevelopment
items.summary: Approved an $800,000 Community Preservation Act appropriation to the Medford Housing Authority for predevelopment costs on the Walkling Court public housing redevelopment.

items.title: Resolution: Medicaid and MassHealth Redetermination
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an administrative update on outreach and language assistance for residents navigating the end of pandemic-era Medicaid continuous coverage.

items.title: Proposed Charter Amendment: Council Staff and Legal Counsel
items.summary: Referred a proposed city charter amendment authorizing City Council staff and independent legal counsel to committee meetings and scheduled a public hearing for May 23, 2023.

items.title: Proposed Charter Amendment: Municipal Budget Powers
items.summary: Referred a proposed city charter amendment regarding city council budgetary modification powers to committee and scheduled a public hearing for May 23, 2023.

items.title: Proposed Charter Amendment: Mayoral Board Appointments
items.summary: Referred a proposed city charter amendment requiring City Council confirmation of mayoral appointments to boards and commissions to committee and scheduled a public hearing for May 23, 2023.

items.title: Resolution: Tufts University Sidewalk Safety
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the DPW address sidewalk overcrowding and pedestrian safety at the College Avenue and Boston Avenue intersection.

items.title: Resolution: Riverside Avenue Road Resurfacing
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting prioritized resurfacing and pothole repairs on Riverside Avenue, amended to include coordination with MWRA and National Grid.

items.title: Resolution: Multilingual City Hall Signage
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting directional signage and guides in common non-English languages inside City Hall.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendment: Human Resources Director
items.summary: Ruled out of order an ordinance amendment creating a CAF-19 salary grade for the Human Resources Director because a substantially similar paper was disposed of within the prior 90 days.

items.title: Food Truck Permits
items.summary: Approved food truck permits for Boston Glory Games, Work Hard Eat Good, and The Sausage Guys.

items.title: Report Request: Free Cash Explanation
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting the administration explain how the city's $25 million free cash balance was calculated and delineate its allowable uses.

items.title: Loan Order: Sidewalk Construction and Equipment Bonds
items.summary: Approved on third reading a borrowing loan order for sidewalk construction and departmental equipment.

items.title: Non-Union Personnel COLA and Free Cash Appropriation
items.summary: Approved on third reading a cost-of-living adjustment for non-union personnel excluding elected officials, followed by an $80,000 appropriation from free cash to fund the retroactive pay.
